/**
 * HARD GATE for the narrow Codex-findings guard fix (orchestrator-owned; do not edit).
 * base = production's guard (origin/main == 30327d9), new = this worktree.
 * Rule: no caption that base REJECTS may be ACCEPTED by new (client or server),
 * except rows explicitly listed in ALLOWED_RELAXATIONS (the one false-refusal
 * finding, "Celebrating Local Heroes"-style collective participial openers).
 * Also: new client === new server on every row (parity).
 * Writes a full table to oracle-report.txt.
 */
import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from "node:fs";
import { resolve } from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { captionUsesOnlyExpectedCustomer as clientNewFn } from "../../../utils/captionQuality";
import { captionUsesOnlyExpectedCustomer as clientBaseFn } from "./base/captionQuality";

type WP = { containsUnexpectedCustomerIdentity(t: string, c: string | undefined, a: unknown[]): boolean; groundedIdentityPhrase(p: string): unknown };
const loadPb = (rel: string): WP => { const src = readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), rel), "utf8"); const module = { exports: {} as WP }; new Function("module", "exports", src)(module, module.exports); return module.exports; };
const srvNew = loadPb("pb_hooks/websitePublications.js");
const srvBase = loadPb("__tests__/__scratch__/oracle/base/websitePublications.js");
const DEALER = "Bob Maxey Ford of Howell", OEM = "Ford", SALESPERSON = "Joe Gallant";
const server = (w: WP) => (caption: string, customer?: string, vehicle?: string) => !w.containsUnexpectedCustomerIdentity(caption, customer, [w.groundedIdentityPhrase(DEALER), w.groundedIdentityPhrase(OEM), SALESPERSON, "Joe", w.groundedIdentityPhrase(vehicle || "")]);
const client = (fn: typeof clientNewFn) => (caption: string, customer?: string, vehicle?: string) => fn(caption, customer, { allowedPhrases: [DEALER, OEM, vehicle], maskedPhrases: [SALESPERSON, "Joe"], rejectAnyCustomerIdentity: !customer });

type Row = { caption: string; customer?: string; vehicle?: string; safe: boolean };
const corpus: Row[] = JSON.parse(readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), "__tests__/__scratch__/oracle/corpus-5850.json"), "utf8"));
const baselineParity = new Set(readFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), "__tests__/__scratch__/oracle/baseline-parity.txt"), "utf8").split("\n").filter(Boolean).map((l) => l.replace(/ newClient=.*$/, "")));
const extraPath = resolve(process.cwd(), "__tests__/__scratch__/oracle/extra-rows.json");
let extra: Row[] = []; try { extra = JSON.parse(readFileSync(extraPath, "utf8")); } catch { /* optional */ }

// Only the false-refusal finding may relax base: collective noun phrases after a participial opener,
// and only on rows whose expected verdict is ACCEPT (a relaxation that carries a real name is a violation).
const ALLOWED_RELAXATIONS = [/\b(Celebrating|Honoring|Honouring|Welcoming|Thanking|Supporting|Recognizing|Recognising|Saluting)\s+(Local|Our|The|All|Every)\b/];

describe("narrow guard fix — hard gate vs production", () => {
  it("never accepts what production refuses (except the listed relaxation) and keeps client/server parity", () => {
    const rows = [...corpus, ...extra];
    const out: string[] = [];
    const violations: string[] = [], parity: string[] = [], moved: string[] = [];
    let improvedLeaks = 0, relaxed = 0;
    for (const r of rows) {
      const bC = client(clientBaseFn)(r.caption, r.customer, r.vehicle), bS = server(srvBase)(r.caption, r.customer, r.vehicle);
      const nC = client(clientNewFn)(r.caption, r.customer, r.vehicle), nS = server(srvNew)(r.caption, r.customer, r.vehicle);
      const base = bC && bS, next = nC && nS; // accept only when both sides accept
      const tag = JSON.stringify({ caption: r.caption, customer: r.customer, vehicle: r.vehicle });
      if (nC !== nS && !baselineParity.has(tag)) parity.push(tag + ` newClient=${nC} newServer=${nS}`);
      if (base !== next) {
        const line = `${base ? "ACCEPT" : "REJECT"}→${next ? "ACCEPT" : "REJECT"} expect=${r.safe ? "ACCEPT" : "REJECT"} ${tag}`;
        moved.push(line);
        if (!base && next) { if (r.safe && ALLOWED_RELAXATIONS.some((re) => re.test(r.caption))) relaxed++; else violations.push(line); }
        if (base && !next && !r.safe) improvedLeaks++;
      }
    }
    out.push(`rows=${rows.length} (corpus ${corpus.length} + extra ${extra.length})`);
    out.push(`moved=${moved.length} closedLeaks(base ACCEPT→REJECT on expect-REJECT)=${improvedLeaks} allowedRelaxations=${relaxed}`);
    out.push(`VIOLATIONS (base REJECT → new ACCEPT, not allowed)=${violations.length}`);
    out.push(`NEW PARITY MISMATCHES (new client ≠ new server, beyond the 27 production already has)=${parity.length}`);
    out.push("", "== violations ==", ...violations, "", "== parity ==", ...parity, "", "== all moved rows ==", ...moved);
    writeFileSync(resolve(process.cwd(), "__tests__/__scratch__/oracle/oracle-report.txt"), out.join("\n"));
    console.log(out.slice(0, 4).join("\n"));
    expect(violations).toEqual([]);
    expect(parity).toEqual([]);
  }, 600_000);
});
